summary: Synthomer is czech chemical company, founded in 1990. About 353 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Czech koruna 4.8 billion (2023). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 3 about acquisitions; 1 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Synthomer is a London-listed specialty polymers maker with about 3,900 staff and a Dutch site in Middelburg, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A UK chemicals company, listed in London since 1971, with about 3,900 employees, 5 innovation centres and more than 29 factories in Europe, North America and Asia.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (Synthomer Middelburg B.V.).

growth.text: Raised its 2026 outlook after first-half revenue rose 6.7%.
Completed the sale of its Czech acrylate monomers business.

worth_knowing.text: Debt remains a challenge for the company despite a boost from the Gulf region.
Major shareholder KLK booked a large impairment on its Synthomer stake.
